scope: Fresh hosted guest profile on the published Store CRX; page-grounded first answer, same-conversation follow-up, and a new conversation after panel reload.
proven: Fresh guest profile had no access token, user profile, or active organization.
Opening answer completed without sign-in/paywall/error, contained the unpredictable page code, and named the page stages in order.
Same-conversation follow-up completed with verified conversation identity and the page code.
After panel reload, a new conversation completed and contained the unpredictable page code.
Three observed AI requests returned HTTP 200; the first and post-reload requests were new conversations and the middle request reused the conversation fingerprint.
limitations: Observer attached after panel load; pre-attachment requests are unobserved.
This is bounded guest Chat T10 evidence, not broad Chat coverage.
